public_rationale: The unresolved-harms component is supported at the level of the broad risks discussed in the launch materials. OpenAI described mitigations and remaining limitations, not complete solutions. The disclosure component is contradicted on its plain reading: the report provided substantive information about training and model operation. Marcus's narrower possible point—that crucial details needed for independent scrutiny were withheld—is supported, but that is stronger qualification than his word nothing supplies.
limitations: The result turns partly on how literally nothing is read.
Safety improvements should not be mistaken for complete solutions, but neither should unresolved risks imply that no useful mitigation existed.
The harm assessment concerns broad launch-period risk categories.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI has solved none of the potential harms it recently warned of, and it discloses nothing about how its models work.

statement.excerpt: Note that the same logic applies to essentially every potential harm OpenAI recently warned of. None are solved, and we are told nothing about how the models work.

from_speaker: essentially every potential harm OpenAI recently warned of
we are told nothing about how the models work
our_interpretation: The two components are assessed separately: whether the warned-of risk categories remained unresolved, and whether OpenAI disclosed any substantive information about model operation.
Recently refers to the GPT-4 launch warnings and disclosures preceding the March 18 post.
Solved means a broad harm category had been reliably eliminated or prevented; reducing its frequency or blocking selected prompts is mitigation.
The ordinary reading of nothing is no substantive technical disclosure. A narrower reading meaning insufficient detail for independent reproduction is recorded as an alternative.
The target is March 14–18, 2023, the latest public launch and disclosure period before the post.
criteria.support_condition: The launch materials describe the warned-of broad harms as unresolved despite mitigations, and disclose no substantive information about how the model operates or is trained.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence establishes a complete solution to a warned-of broad harm, or identifies substantive public information about model operation or training. If only one component is contradicted while the other is supported, the combined claim is mixed.

evidence.locator: Appended GPT-4 System Card, section 1, Introduction
evidence.explanation: The system card presents the broad risk categories as continuing problems requiring research and mitigation, not completed solutions. It also reports safety improvements and limited dangerous capabilities, which qualify the criticism without establishing elimination of those risks.

evidence.locator: Technical report, section 2, Scope and Limitations of this Technical Report
evidence.explanation: The report disclosed a training method, alongside the Transformer model family and next-token training objective. It withheld model size, detailed architecture, compute and dataset construction, supporting a criticism of limited transparency but contradicting a literal claim of no disclosure.
